name: bar-ranking
description: Horizontal bars ranked by value with labels and values; highlight the leaders, mark a threshold.

parameters.name: rows
parameters.description: list of (label, value), top to bottom

parameters.name: max_value
parameters.description: the value of a full-width bar; default the largest value

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: full bar width in scene units

parameters.name: colors
parameters.description: row index → colour; other rows are muted; default {0: ACCENT}

parameters.name: fmt
parameters.description: format of the value text, e.g. "{:.1f}" or "{:,.0f}"

parameters.name: label_w
parameters.description: widest a label may be before it shrinks

returns: VGroup with .rows (each VGroup(label, bar, value)); grow(chart) reveals them; value_x(chart, v) gives a value's x
